messages:
lina-sales: Need a one-paragraph FAQ for FinBank's air-gapped POC: packaging, upgrade cadence, rollback, SBOM/licenses, and a quick cost estimate.
ark-engineer: Offline bundle = self-contained tarball (binaries, models, install scripts). No outbound network calls. Bundles are GPG-signed and include sha256 checksums.
tara-security: Recommend maintenance pattern: monthly security fixes + quarterly feature releases. Require written maintenance windows and DB/artifact snapshots pre-upgrade.
sam-fieldeng: Rollback: `redwoodctl rollback --to <bundle-id>` restores prior binaries/artifacts. Note: DB/schema migrations can be irreversible; always snapshot before.
finance-rep: Ballpark: offline packaging/signing = $4,000 one-time; remote weekend upgrade support = $12,000 flat; optional onsite = $6,000/day + travel.
lina-sales: Action items I will send: 1) SPDX SBOM + license table (ark) 2) signed bundle proof + verify steps (ark) 3) upgrade playbook + rollback checklist (sam) 4) quote PDF with options (finance) 5) note about FIPS/HSM availability and timeline (tara/ark). I'll ask them for preferred maintenance windows and POC dates.
ark-engineer: I'll attach a tiny sample SBOM and the `redwoodctl` install/rollback snippets for the customer.
